statement: The University of Florida blueberry breeding programme publishes measured values for Optimus 'FL08-262' of firmness of 241 g/mm at harvest falling to 219 g/mm after 21 days, average berry weight of 1.7 g, average diameter of 15.8 mm and average soluble solids of 12.3 degrees Brix. The firmness figures use the programme's own g/mm compression index and are not directly comparable with firmness figures produced by other methods.
